================================================================================
empty initializers in if and switch
================================================================================

package main

func f(x bool, v interface{}) {
	if ; x {
	}
	switch ; {
	}
	switch ; x {
	}
	switch ; v.(type) {
	}
	switch ; y := v.(type) {
	}
}

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

(source_file
  (package_clause
    (package_identifier))
  (function_declaration
    name: (identifier)
    parameters: (parameter_list
      (parameter_declaration
        name: (identifier)
        type: (type_identifier))
      (parameter_declaration
        name: (identifier)
        type: (interface_type)))
    body: (block
      (statement_list
        (if_statement
          condition: (identifier)
          consequence: (block))
        (expression_switch_statement)
        (expression_switch_statement
          value: (identifier))
        (type_switch_statement
          value: (identifier))
        (type_switch_statement
          alias: (expression_list
            (identifier))
          value: (identifier))))))

================================================================================
empty statement before a statement on the same line
================================================================================

package main

func f() { ; println("x") }

func g() { a(); ; b() }

func h() { a();; b() }

func i() {
	;;
}

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

        (empty_statement)
        (expression_statement
          (call_expression
            function: (identifier)
            arguments: (argument_list
              (interpreted_string_literal
                (interpreted_string_literal_content))))))))
  (function_declaration
    name: (identifier)
    parameters: (parameter_list)
    body: (block
      (statement_list
        (expression_statement
          (call_expression
            function: (identifier)
            arguments: (argument_list)))
        (empty_statement)
        (expression_statement
          (call_expression
            function: (identifier)
            arguments: (argument_list))))))
  (function_declaration
    name: (identifier)
    parameters: (parameter_list)
    body: (block
      (statement_list
        (expression_statement
          (call_expression
            function: (identifier)
            arguments: (argument_list)))
        (empty_statement)
        (expression_statement

            function: (identifier)

================================================================================
labels at the end of a block nest
================================================================================

package main

func f() {
L:
L1:
L2:
}

func g() {
	a()
L:
L1:
}

func h(x int) {
	switch x {
	case 1:
	L:
	L1:
	case 2:
	}
}

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

(source_file
  (package_clause
    (package_identifier))
  (function_declaration
    name: (identifier)
    parameters: (parameter_list)
    body: (block
      (statement_list
        (labeled_statement
          label: (label_name)
          (labeled_statement
            label: (label_name)
            (labeled_statement
              label: (label_name)))))))
  (function_declaration
    name: (identifier)
    parameters: (parameter_list)
    body: (block
      (statement_list
        (expression_statement
          (call_expression
            function: (identifier)
            arguments: (argument_list)))
        (labeled_statement
          label: (label_name)
          (labeled_statement
            label: (label_name))))))
  (function_declaration
    name: (identifier)
    parameters: (parameter_list
      (parameter_declaration
        name: (identifier)
        type: (type_identifier)))
    body: (block
      (statement_list
        (expression_switch_statement
          value: (identifier)
          (expression_case
            value: (expression_list
              (int_literal))
            (statement_list
              (labeled_statement
                label: (label_name)
                (labeled_statement
                  label: (label_name)))))
          (expression_case
            value: (expression_list
              (int_literal))))))))

================================================================================
a label before a statement still labels that statement
================================================================================

package main

func f() {
L:
L1:
	a()
	b()
}

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

(source_file
  (package_clause
    (package_identifier))

          (labeled_statement
            label: (label_name)
            (expression_statement
              (call_expression
                function: (identifier)
                arguments: (argument_list)))))
        (expression_statement
          (call_expression
            function: (identifier)
            arguments: (argument_list)))))))
